title: 神戸新聞杯の後に・取り戻したもの

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After running in the Kobe Shimbun Hai, Silence Suzuka appears lighter and refreshed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bolstered by a newfound sense of unwavering determination, Silence Suzuka sets her sights on the autumn Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She still needs more experience in order to reach her lofty goals, so we decide to enter her into the Kinko Sho next.
